Samael items

These items drop from Samael, Herald of the End. They drop locked: a locked item only shows the text below, and must be transmuted in the Horadric Cube with two Greater Signets of Learning, a Lew Rune and a Phul Rune to unlock its stats.

Locked Samael item
Transmute this item with:
Two Greater Signets of Learning
Lew Rune
Phul Rune
To unlock its true power

Valkyrie's Prime

The six Emblems have an ultra low chance to drop from all monsters in Destruction difficulty. Once all six are collected, they can be cubed with the Deity's Bow (20% chance to drop from Athulua, the Amazonian Goddess) to turn it into the special sacred unique bow Valkyrie's Prime; or with the Glorious Book of Median and the Ancient Book (dropped by Archbishop Lazarus and Xazax respectively) to upgrade the former.

Valkyrie's Prime
Sacred Bow
Required Level: 110
Item Level: 105
+(1 to 4) to All Skills
35% Chance to cast level 15 Arrow on Striking
100% Chance to cast level 1 Athulua's Wrath when you Die
+(151 to 200)% Enhanced Damage
Adds 180-220 Damage
Ignore Target's Defense
+(20 to 25) to Sky Siege
Maximum Elemental Resists +(1 to 2)%

Time-Lost Relics

The Time-Lost Relic is cubed with an Essence of Time to uncover a skill, recipe or unique item mod "from the Future, Past, or from a different Timeline entirely". The game currently has 5 possible outcomes, shown below.

Time-Lost Relic
Relic
Required Level: 75
Item Level: 1
Cube with Essence of Time to uncover a Skill, Recipe or Unique item mod
from the Future, Past, or from a different Timeline entirely...

Possible outcomes:

Outcome 1
Time-Lost Relic
Required Level: 75
Chance to Cast level 60 Cone of Cold on Melee Attack equal to your Deadly/Critical Strike chance
Cone of Cold Size increased by 50% per 10 Trophied Charms you have
Outcome 2
Time-Lost Relic
Required Level: 75
While your uncapped Lightning Resist, Lightning Spell Damage and Spell Focus sum up to exactly 2000
Become Lightning Enchanted
(4% Chance to Cast level 50 Spark Nova when Damaged)

Time-Lost Relic
Required Level: 75
+(12 to 16) to Fire Cannonade

Required Level: 75

Outcome 5
Time-Lost Relic
Required Level: 75
+25 to Resurrect
+1 to Body of the Savior

Launches a massive frozen spike that splits into smaller bursts, which split again into small spikes

Version history

Desolation

Version Desolation
2.7
  • Magic damage increased to 4000-5000
2.2.0
  • Halved magic damage from 5000 to 2500
  • Ultimate chaos damage increased by 120%

Despondence

Version Despondence
2.13.0
  • Despair: Aura now reduces enemy physical attack damage and Attack Rating
  • Spell Damage on staff increased from 30 to 50%
  • Added -(20 to 30%) to Enemy Cold Resistance
  • Added (20 to 30) roll to Voidstar

Celestial Sigil

Version Celestial Sigil
2.13.0
  • Old Warp Field aura effects moved to Despondence's Despair (technically it's Void Archon's aura)
  • New Warp Field aura:
  • Reduces enemy movement speed by 20%
  • Nullifies range of most Teleport skills
  • 8 Yard Radius
  • Bloodlust trigger replaced with 1% Chance to Cast level 5 Gift of Celerity on Death Blow
  • All Skills roll increased from (2 to 4) to (2 to 5)
  • 5% Crushing Blow replaced with 5% Innate Elemental Damage

Valkyrie's Prime

Version Valkyrie's Prime
2.14.0
  • Increased Sky Siege roll to 20-25 to support the new cooldown scaling
